_comment: Depth tier definitions used by the research sub-agent. Default = standard. Override via the spawn prompt.

quick.description: Fast lookup. 2-3 sources, single search batch. Use for simple factual questions.

standard.description: Default. 3-5 sources from ≥2 independent outlets. Cross-checked.

deep.description: Investigative. Primary docs + peer-reviewed where applicable. Used for high-stakes or contested topics.
